text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty fired for inference-prod-eu — HIGH 5xx rate, aggregated error rate > 7% over 2m. Pager: urgent. link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-27965

sarah: i'm on call, looking now. assigning to me.

matt: acked and joining bridge — grabbing logs from router and the model pool. bridge: https://zoom.example/abc123

incident-bot: auto-escalation in 5m if not acknowledged by owner.

oliver: quick question — is this limited to longer sequences or across the board? saw trailing kv cache timeouts earlier.

sarah: initial grep shows 502/503 from the model-serving workers, not edge LB. patterns look like a batch executor overload — batch sizes spiking.

carol: I'm seeing a spike in queue depth on dedicated-eu-pool-2: `pending_requests > 1200` and `avg_batch_tokens` doubled. probably autoscaler didn't react in time.

matt: rolling a short mitigation: pin routing to smaller batch profile and scale up pool. executing:

```
redwoodctl routing set inference-ingress --profile=latency-preferred
redwoodctl pool scale dedicated-eu-pool-2 --replicas=+4 --override-autoscale
```

incident-bot: policy change recorded (user:matt).

sarah: applied routing change; switching a subset of traffic to model-quant-v2 as fallback (canary route 10%). verifying correctness now.

oliver: logs show TLS handshakes okay. error stack is `kv_cache: miss -> model_exec: OOM-ish failures` on a few GPUs. could be memory regression from yesterday's runtime tweak.

carol: rolling back runtime flag `--kv-prefetch=on` on eu-serving group to previous default. patching via deploy bot.

matt: autoscaler reacted after manual override, +4 replicas coming up — instance IDs: eu-gpu-78a, eu-gpu-78b, eu-gpu-78c, eu-gpu-78d.

sarah: traffic drop to 2.1% 5xx now, from 7.4%. canary stable. keeping traffic split for another 7m then will lift fallback if stable.

oncall-rotation: thanks all — are there customer-facing incidents or SLO breaches to call out?

carol: temporary latency increase noted for a handful of enterprise customers (queueing), but no errors surfaced to client frontlines after canary. recommend status page: "degraded performance" for inference EU region.

matt: posting temporary status update and customer note. patch & scale looks OK; leaving canary at 10% for 10m.

incident-bot: PagerDuty acknowledged by sarah. escalation suppressed.

sarah: handing ownership to oliver for nighttime coverage — I'll update runbook and add notes: suspected runtime kv-prefetch regression, manual rollback applied, autoscaler override used.

oliver: taking it — I'll monitor through the window. next steps: 1) run full regression test against kv tweak 2) coordinate with infra team for a safe restart of affected nodes 3) postmortem if we see recurrence.

carol: created ticket INF-4921 for follow-up and postmortem, linking logs and canary metrics.

matt: moving autoscale override back to normal after stable period. command: `redwoodctl pool scale dedicated-eu-pool-2 --restore-autoscale`.

sarah: thanks everyone. final note: no direct customer data exposure, impact limited to inference latency/errors. postmortem owner: carol.

oliver: closing the active page in 10m if stability holds. will ping here with final closure. :white_check_mark:
